title: Nutty Sweet Indian Pumpkin Kheer
description: A smoky, glassy-jelly, light Indian dessert made with pumpkin, nuts and caramelized sugar.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the pumpkin puree and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to caramelize, about 10 minutes.
Add the brown sugar, water, coconut milk, cardamom powder, pistachios, salt, cinnamon powder and heavy cream to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture has thickened, about 10 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and add the vanilla extract.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the mixture cool slightly.
Pour the kheer into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate the kheer for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
Serve the kheer cold, garnished with chopped nuts or a sprinkle of cardamom powder if desired.
